Implemented the dependency upgrade adaptation without modifying tests.

Changed:
- Upgraded manifests to `charm.land/bubbletea/v2`, `charm.land/lipgloss/v2`, and `github.com/alecthomas/kong v1.15.0`.
- Updated production imports from `github.com/charmbracelet/...` to `charm.land/...`.
- Changed Bubble Tea `View()` implementations to return `tea.View`.
- Moved alt-screen behavior from `tea.WithAltScreen()` to `tea.View{AltScreen: true}`.
- Updated key handling to use `tea.KeyPressMsg`.
- Added a local compatibility replacement for the old `github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea` import path so unchanged local tests don’t pull the incompatible v1 dependency graph.

- `GOTOOLCHAIN=auto go build ./...` passes.
- `GOTOOLCHAIN=auto go test ./...` still fails only because existing `internal/tui/view_test.go` expects `View()` to return `string`; with Bubble Tea v2 it now returns `tea.View` and upgraded tests should use `.Content`. I did not modify tests per constraint.
